correct_diagnosis: Major depressive disorder, first episode, moderate severity
matching_criterion: Major depressive disorder (major depressive episode), first episode, of moderate severity. Any wording that names a major depressive episode/depressive disorder of moderate severity counts as correct; adjustment disorder, bipolar depression or hypothyroidism as the final diagnosis does not.

management_reference.management: Offer a first-line treatment: either structured psychotherapy (CBT, interpersonal therapy or behavioural activation) or a first-line antidepressant, according to preference and availability.
management_reference.source_quote: CBT, interpersonal therapy (IPT), and BA as first-line recommended psychological treatments for the acute treatment of MDD

management_reference.management: Structured psychotherapies and first-line antidepressants are equally effective in the short term; choose according to patient preference.
management_reference.source_quote: Structured psychotherapies and first-line antidepressant medications are equally effective in treating MDD in the short term

management_reference.management: Use psychoeducation when prescribing: risks and benefits, time course of effect, and dispelling myths about medication.
management_reference.source_quote: Clinicians should use psychoeducation when prescribing medications, including discussing risks and benefits, the time course of effect, and dispelling myths and misbeliefs about medication use

management_reference.management: Use measurement-based care (PHQ-9) to monitor response.
management_reference.source_quote: can be used for subsequent monitoring during measurement-based care

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
